content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a way to customize the login page in the [product_name] Web Editor? For example, instead of the default image, could I use my organization's logo or display instructions? Thanks
Hello [user_name], From my understanding, you cannot modify the login page.
Hi! What about the "Pages-Create Login page" option in [product_name] Web Editor [version_no]?

Thank you, that worked and let me create a customized login page. While testing, I noticed it wouldn't work with my older test setup that had an earlier module, but on a newer [version_no] module it was successful. The newer module also allowed multiple users to view the page simultaneously, which wasn't possible with the older modules.

Hello [user_name], As far as I know, this isn't supported in the current version either. I tried it before with an older module, but it seemed more like a bug. This feature isn't officially intended by [company_name], unless accessed through a cloud service like AWS. [user_name] (Translated using Google)

Hi [user_name], After reading your comment about multiple simultaneous access, I double-checked and can confirm that I was connected to the [product_name] Web Editor page from several devices at the same time, all displaying the same information, including my phone, my partner's phone, a tablet, and a PC. This wasn't an AWS project. Maybe it's just an unexpected benefit? Thanks

Not that I'm aware of. With [version_no] it worked sporadically but was unstable. Sadly, I don't have a recent module to test further. The manual doesn't mention support for multiple simultaneous users. Maybe [company_name] could provide clarification or you could open a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants explored how to personalize the login page of the [product_name] Web Editor, noting that newer versions and modules provide more flexibility for customization. They also discovered that simultaneous multi-user access works only in certain versions, is inconsistently documented, and seems to vary by hardware generation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to customize the Web Editor login page with branding or instructions and want reliable, officially supported concurrent access for multiple users.
